items.description: Xquisite Graphics is a printing and graphic design business based in Daspoort, Pretoria. Its range of services covers litho and digital printing alongside vinyl stickers, signs and signboards, and shopfronts for retail premises. The business also produces display banners, invitations, and diaries, and handles vehicle branding and corporate clothing for companies wanting consistent branded apparel. Additional offerings include personalised wine labels, corporate gifts, CD duplication, party supplies, product branding, and nameplates and badges, as well as bottled water branding. Alongside its print and signage work, Xquisite Graphics designs and builds websites, with advertising packages starting from a low entry price, and offers web optimisation services to help clients improve their online visibility. The combination of physical branding, from banners and vehicle wraps to printed stationery, with affordable web design and hosting gives small and medium Pretoria businesses a single supplier for both their print materials and their online presence.

Y2K Print and Design is a printing business in Sinoville, Pretoria, with a client base dating back to the year 2000. It offers a range of printing and delivery services, producing business cards, flyers, booklets, posters, stickers, banners, and T-shirts for individuals and companies. The business positions itself on competitive pricing and a quick turnaround time, aiming to deliver quality printed products within a short timeframe. Its team handles enquiries about pricing, design requirements, and order specifications directly, helping customers bring their branding ideas to life. Y2K Print and Design operates from Monday to Friday during standard business hours and is closed over weekends. With more than two decades in the Sinoville printing trade, the business has built a following through word of mouth and repeat custom, and maintains an active social media page where past and prospective customers can see examples of completed printing work.

Zanshin Karate Dojo Les Marais is an owner-run karate school in Les Marais, Pretoria, affiliated with the South African Japan Karate Association. Classes are structured for both children and adults, with an emphasis on correct technique, character development, and individual attention regardless of a student's experience level. Instruction covers everything from foundational stances and movements for newcomers through to grading and competition preparation for more advanced students. The dojo describes itself as a disciplined yet supportive training environment, where members progress together while building skill, discipline, and camaraderie. Facilities at the venue include wheelchair accessible parking. As part of the wider SA JKA network, the dojo follows the organisation's established curriculum and grading structure, giving students a recognised pathway for advancement within the sport. Training sessions are held at the dojo's own premises on Jarvis Avenue, where instruction focuses on close, hands-on coaching rather than large group classes.

Zetty Electrical Wholesale is an electrical wholesaler based in Centurion, stocking more than 12,500 electrical product lines across nine departments. These include power distribution and control, termination and wiring, control and signalling, field switching, sensing and safety, motor control and motors, automation, and monitoring and drives, with dozens of sub-categories within each department. Customers can build an order online without paying upfront; the business then confirms stock and pricing before preparing the order for payment by card or electronic funds transfer. Completed orders are delivered across Gauteng and the rest of South Africa by courier, or can be collected directly from the Centurion premises. Zetty also offers cash-on-delivery trading accounts for approved customers, provides product datasheets on request, and displays pricing inclusive of VAT throughout its catalogue. The combination of a large in-stock range with nationwide delivery and trade account options positions the business as a supplier for electrical contractors, panel builders, and industrial customers needing dependable access to stock.

items.description: 3%.Com Properties, trading through NEA Inc., is a real estate business that combines the roles of attorney and estate agent within a single service for property buyers and sellers. Rather than engaging a separate conveyancing attorney and a selling agent, clients dealing with NEA Inc. work with one team that manages both the sale or purchase process and the associated legal transfer work. The business positions this combined approach as a way to avoid the high commission rates, hidden costs, and legal complications that can arise when multiple parties are involved in a property transaction. NEA Inc. operates from three offices: one at Midlands Office Park in Midstream Estate, one in Centurion, and one in Potchefstroom, allowing it to serve clients across these areas. Prospective buyers and sellers can view current property listings through the business and get connected with the relevant office for their area and transaction type.

40 on Ilkey is a guesthouse in a quiet, secure suburb near the Menlyn Hub commercial precinct in Pretoria, managed as accommodation for both business and leisure travellers. Rooms are described as comfortable and well-appointed, with quality bedding, and the property includes dedicated workspaces for guests who need to work during their stay. High-speed WiFi is available throughout the premises, along with secure on-site parking and a flexible, efficient check-in process. The guesthouse markets itself particularly toward business travellers needing a reliable base, corporate stays and longer bookings, and shorter stopovers in Pretoria, as well as guests simply looking for a peaceful, secure environment away from the city centre. Its grounds include a rose garden, noted as being particularly attractive when in bloom. Positioned close to Pretoria's key business and lifestyle destinations, 40 on Ilkey aims to offer a calm retreat without sacrificing convenient access to the surrounding commercial area.

A&J Plastics operates an irrigation supplies business from Koedoespoort Industrial in Pretoria, selling products through an online shop as well as in person. Its range covers LDPE piping in multiple sizes, irrigation fittings such as couplings, elbows, tees and universal shrub adaptors, and rotator nozzles and sprinkler heads from brands including Hunter. The business also stocks pump-related equipment, including pressure switches, control boxes, pressure tanks and bladders for pressure tanks, aimed at customers setting up or maintaining irrigation and water-pumping systems. Beyond core irrigation lines, its catalogue extends into drip irrigation, filtration, water tanks, pool supplies, plumbing fittings, valves, garden tools and irrigation controllers, giving it a broad spread of products for home and small-scale agricultural watering needs. Customers can browse stock availability and current pricing, shown inclusive of VAT, directly through the online store before deciding whether to order online or collect from the Koedoespoort premises.

AB Tinting is a window tinting business based in Elardus Park, Pretoria, that has completed more than 175 projects. Its core offering is a window tinting service for both homes and businesses, alongside vinyl application work for vehicles and other surfaces. The business describes its approach as centred on open communication with clients, going through available product and window treatment options with each customer before work begins, including being upfront about which products or window types are not suitable for a particular job. Site visits typically involve bringing physical samples so customers can see and compare options in person before committing to an installation. Once a job is booked, the business aims for punctual, efficient on-site work, completing vinyl and window tinting installations without unnecessary delay. Through repeat work for both private homeowners and businesses referring further clients, AB Tinting has built up a track record across a large number of completed tinting and vinyl application projects in the Pretoria area.

ABANTU Coffee operates a coffee shop at Eco Park in Centurion, part of a small chain of container-style coffee outlets found in several locations. Each outlet is built around a compact, modern design intended to create a welcoming space for customers whether they are picking up a quick cup on the way somewhere or settling in to work or meet with others. Coffee is handcrafted on site, and the Eco Park location offers free WiFi along with a relaxed, casual atmosphere suited to both quick visits and longer stays. Beyond the coffee itself, the brand maintains an ongoing community blog where it shares stories tied to its locations and the people behind the business, positioning itself as more than a simple coffee counter. The container-style format allows the chain to establish outlets in a range of settings while keeping a consistent look and feel across its different coffee shop locations, including the one serving the Eco Park area.

Abland Property Developers runs a property development business from offices in Doringkloof, Centurion, working across several categories of development. These include office, retail, industrial, residential, and motor-dealership properties, reflecting a spread across both commercial and residential property types rather than a single specialism. The business maintains a record of completed developments alongside current development opportunities, and operates a vacancy schedule listing space available within its property portfolio for prospective tenants. It also runs a broker registration process, through which property brokers can register to work with the business on deals involving its developments, and shares project updates through a publication for its industry contacts. By covering multiple property categories from one base in Centurion, Abland positions itself as a developer able to take on a range of project types rather than concentrating on one sector of the property market.

ABYX Chemical Company manufactures and distributes a range of industrial and consumer cleaning chemicals from its base in Pretoria, with an SABS ISO 9001 certification covering its manufacturing operations. Its product range spans categories including bathroom, dish-washing, industrial, laundry, motor, outdoor, and personal care cleaning products, sold both to retail stockists and directly through its own online shop. The business promotes a reuse-and-refill scheme, encouraging customers to bring back marked bottles for refilling rather than buying new packaging each time. ABYX traces its origins to 1966, when it was registered as Strat-Chem after early experiments producing a car polish and a dishwashing liquid sold door to door, before the company grew into a dedicated chemical manufacturer. From its Pretoria base, the business now delivers its cleaning products to customers across Pretoria itself as well as Polokwane, Middelburg, Rustenburg, Vereeniging, Welkom, and Johannesburg, supplying both individual consumers and bulk industrial buyers.

items.description: ACPAS is a fintech software provider based in Doringkloof, Centurion, building systems for businesses operating in the credit industry. Its core product is a loan management system that covers the full loan cycle, from customer onboarding and pay-date management through to collections, alongside payment collection tools that use DebiCheck for automated debit processing. The business also offers custom financial management systems and builds bespoke websites for lending businesses through its own website design service. Additional modules include electronic signature tools for paperless document handling, performance and operational reporting, integrated credit insurance products, and automated credit scorecard and vetting tools to help lenders assess applicants. ACPAS positions its offering around automating manual lending processes, aiming to reduce the administrative load on credit providers while giving them tighter oversight of their loan books. Clients can request a demonstration of the platform before deciding which combination of loan management, collections, and website services best suits their business.

African Chef Monavoni is a restaurant in Centurion serving African cuisine, available for both takeout and sit-down dining. The menu draws on traditional dishes, with diners commonly ordering items such as chicken, ribs, and other meat-based dishes alongside side dishes, and the restaurant has also hosted sit-down functions such as family celebrations. Staff are typically involved in explaining dishes and taking orders directly from customers, and the restaurant maintains a casual, cosy setting suited to both quick takeaway visits and longer, relaxed meals. Pricing at African Chef Monavoni generally falls in a mid-range bracket of roughly ZAR 100 to ZAR 350 per person, making it accessible for regular meals as well as slightly larger group orders. The restaurant operates from a unit on Marais Avenue in the Monavoni area of Centurion, serving the surrounding residential community with a mix of everyday African dishes and occasional special-occasion catering.

African Earth Computers, also trading as AE Computers, operates from Plaza Link Centre on Codonia Avenue in Waverley, Pretoria. Services listed for the business include computer screen repairs and a general service and repairs offering for computer hardware. Customers with a damaged screen or another hardware fault on a desktop or laptop can bring their equipment to the Plaza Link Centre premises, where the business assesses the problem and carries out the necessary repair work on site. As a computer repair business operating from a single location within the shopping centre, African Earth Computers serves customers from Waverley and the surrounding Pretoria suburbs who need hands-on support for computer hardware problems, including screen damage and other faults affecting desktop and laptop machines.

African Sun Mining (Pty) Ltd is a 100% Black-owned opencast mining contractor established in 2011, operating from Montana Park in Pretoria. Its core services cover opencast mining, including mine rehabilitation work, along with load and haul operations, the establishment of decline shafts, crushing and screening, and bulk earthworks for mining clients. The business also offers blasting, drilling, equipment and plant hire, and road maintenance services to support mining operations more broadly. African Sun Mining has adopted a business strategy intended to position it within the opencast mining industry specifically, rather than general construction or civil work, and it states a commitment to building long-term, ethical partnerships with its clients and maintaining a quality control system across its mining and earthworks projects. The company also describes a workplace commitment to safety, aiming for zero tolerance of safety lapses across the mining and earthmoving services it provides to clients in the sector.

items.description: Agricoal provides logistics services from Monument Park in Pretoria, with more than ten years of experience operating across Southern Africa. The business runs its own fleet of trucks and offers bulk road transport alongside bagged and palletised cargo handling, moving commodities such as coal, maize, soya beans, lime, water, and various minerals for its clients. Its service covers the full product life cycle around a shipment, including loading, delivery, processing, and after-sales support once cargo has reached its destination. Agricoal works through relationships with subcontractors, brokers, customers, and suppliers across the logistics industry, positioning itself as a turnkey partner able to coordinate multiple parts of a transport chain rather than handling only one leg of a delivery. By combining its own trucking fleet with these established industry relationships, the business aims to offer tailored transport solutions for a range of bulk commodities moving within the Southern African region.

AJ Kempen Incorporated is a law firm based in Erasmusrand, Pretoria, offering legal services across several fields including property law and valuations, family law, labour law, and late estates. Its property law work covers the kind of matters involved in buying and selling property, while its family law and late estate services deal with matters such as divorces, maintenance disputes, and the administration of deceased estates. The firm also provides property valuation services, giving clients an independent assessment of a property's worth alongside any legal work being carried out on it. Clients working with AJ Kempen Incorporated on a property transaction typically deal with one firm for both the legal and valuation side of the matter rather than engaging separate specialists for each. The firm maintains a legal vlog where it shares information related to its areas of practice, aimed at helping clients understand legal processes before they need to make use of its services.

All Wellness Spa is a day spa in Capital Park, Pretoria, offering therapeutic and relaxation treatments from premises situated on the Capital Ridge mountain range. The spa's offerings grew out of a natural health therapy practice that began in 2006, and treatments today include a wellness assessment service that gives clients personalised feedback on their health and points to focus on to help reduce health risks. All Wellness Spa also runs a membership club, through which members pay a set discounted rate for a 50-minute spa treatment rather than the standard price, alongside separate monthly treatment specials advertised to the wider public. The spa operates with a team of specialists who work together on treatments and client care, rather than relying on a single therapist for every booking. Positioned as a place for clients to step away from daily stress, All Wellness Spa combines its health-assessment approach with ongoing membership and promotional offers aimed at encouraging repeat visits.

Aluminium Experts is an aluminium and glass company based in Montana Park, Pretoria, operating since 2006. The business designs, manufactures, and installs aluminium windows and doors engineered for South African conditions, alongside shopfronts built to showcase a retailer's brand while keeping the premises secure. It also undertakes bespoke aluminium projects, developing custom solutions from initial concept through to installation for clients whose requirements fall outside its standard window, door, and shopfront ranges. Aluminium Experts works across both residential and commercial projects, having completed house renovations as well as larger commercial and hospitality developments that called for tailored aluminium and glass work. Each project is treated individually, with specialists guiding clients through design, product choices, and installation from the first enquiry through to completion. Having operated in the aluminium and glass sector since 2006, the business presents its combination of design input, manufacturing, and installation as giving clients a single point of contact for aluminium and glass work of varying scale and complexity.

Aluminium Solution manufactures and installs aluminium windows and doors from its base in Pretoria West. Its product range is organised around aluminium doors and aluminium windows as core lines, alongside a frameless solution aimed at clients wanting a more minimal, glass-forward look without visible aluminium framing. Customers choosing aluminium windows or doors can select from a colour chart covering the available finish options before placing an order, allowing the business to match installations to a property's existing exterior or interior colour scheme. The business maintains a record of recent projects and shares company news with past and prospective clients, giving an ongoing view of the kind of installations it has carried out. Operating from Pretoria West, Aluminium Solution positions itself within the aluminium window and door market as a manufacturer able to handle both standard product lines and the frameless option for clients seeking a different aesthetic from conventional framed aluminium glazing.

Alwinco is an independent security risk assessment company based in Ninapark, Pretoria. Rather than selling or installing security products such as alarms, cameras, or access control systems, the business focuses solely on assessing an organisation's security vulnerabilities from multiple angles and reporting on what it finds. Because it has no financial stake in whichever security products or installers a client eventually chooses, Alwinco positions its assessments as unbiased, distinguishing a genuine, in-depth security risk assessment from what it describes as a more superficial, cosmetic review that some other providers may offer instead. The company uses its own established assessment methodology, carried out by its own consultants, and maintains case studies illustrating past assessment work for different types of clients. Alwinco's assessments are aimed at residential, commercial, and industrial clients who want an independent view of where their security gaps lie before deciding what, if anything, to change about their existing security arrangements.

Amahle Property Solutions is a real estate agency based in Pretoria North, helping clients buy, sell, and rent residential and investment property. Alongside facilitating a sale or rental, the agency places emphasis on educating clients through the process itself, aiming to leave buyers and sellers better equipped to make informed property decisions in future rather than treating each transaction as a one-off event. Its client base includes individual sellers and renters, developers looking to develop land, and investors wanting to turn cash into a property asset, with the agency positioning its sales team as equipped to support each of these different kinds of clients. Listings handled by the agency have included smaller investment properties as well as larger commercial space available to rent, spanning areas such as Mabopane, Sunnyside, and Montana in addition to its Pretoria North base. Clients can search current listings by reference number or by browsing categories such as properties for sale, for rent, and those already sold or rented.

Amalooloo is a sanitation technology business based in Koedoespoort Industrial, Pretoria, that developed and patented its own pre-cast concrete toilet structure. Built around what it calls the Amalooloo Holistic, Sustainable and Ecological Sanitation System, the product is designed to provide health and hygiene benefits beyond those of a conventional toilet structure. The system is aimed particularly at people who do not have immediate access to a toilet that is safe, private, and easy to use, positioning the business's sanitation structures as a practical response to that gap rather than a general plumbing or construction product. Because the structure is pre-cast, installations can be put in place without the extended on-site construction work that a conventional brick-and-mortar toilet block would require. Amalooloo's focus on holistic sanitation also extends to the health and hygiene outcomes it aims to improve for the people using its toilet structures, rather than treating the toilet purely as a piece of built infrastructure.

items.description: Any-Print is a printing company in Pretoria North that was previously known as Auto-Print before being officially renamed Any-Print in 2021. The rebrand followed the death of the business's previous owner in 2019, after the company had already been trading for more than ten years, with the family then deciding to update the name and offering to suit changing customer needs. Having also traded through the Covid-19 pandemic, the business today offers digital printing services covering business cards, flyers, brochures, invitations and programs, photographic canvases, and banners, alongside copying services for existing documents. Its graphic design service covers logo design, packaging design, and broader branding work, supporting customers who need new visual identity material rather than just printed output. Any-Print also provides laminating and binding services, including plastic, wire, and thermal binding, rounding out a range aimed at both individual customers and businesses needing printed and bound materials produced locally in Pretoria North.

items.description: Apple Property Connection is a real estate agency operating in Pierre van Ryneveld, Centurion, as part of the wider Apple Property group. The agency is run by a team with more than thirty years of combined experience in the local property market, drawing on long-standing knowledge of the Pierre van Ryneveld area and the surrounding parts of Centurion when assisting clients. Its work covers helping clients market and sell residential property in the area, as well as handling rental and other property transactions for both individual homeowners and investors. Being part of the broader Apple Property group gives the Pierre van Ryneveld office access to shared marketing and administrative resources used across the group's other branches, while still focusing its day-to-day work on properties within its own local area. The agency's long-standing presence in Pierre van Ryneveld has allowed it to build an ongoing track record of property sales and rentals within this specific part of Centurion.

items.description: Arrabon Trading, also known as Arrabon Medical Solutions, is a medical equipment supplier based in the Imperium Business Park in Hennopspark, Centurion. Its product range covers ambulance and emergency equipment, general medical equipment, and medical accessories, along with single patient use devices intended for one-time clinical use. The business also supplies corpse handling and mortuary equipment, extending its range beyond typical clinical and emergency products into equipment used by funeral and mortuary services. A further product category, branded MediSensor, forms part of its broader medical equipment offering. Arrabon Trading is open to customers from Monday to Friday between 8:00am and 4:30pm, and is closed on weekends and South African public holidays. By covering ambulance, general medical, mortuary, and single-use product categories from one supplier, the business aims to give healthcare and related service providers a single point of contact for several different types of specialised medical equipment.

Atvantage Project Managers and Quantity Surveyors is a built-environment professional services group operating from Southdowns Estate in Centurion, with a track record spanning more than twenty years. The business provides project management, cost consulting, and procurement services to clients across the residential, retail, commercial, industrial, government, and leisure sectors. Its project management work covers the full development process, from feasibility studies and design coordination through to construction oversight and final handover of a completed project. Within the hospitality and tourism sector specifically, Atvantage has worked on developments such as luxury hotels, resorts, and marinas, while its residential and estate work covers secure residential developments more broadly. By combining project management with cost consulting and procurement under one group, the business aims to manage several stages of a development, from early planning through to construction completion, without clients needing to coordinate separate specialists for each function.

items.description: AVBOB Insurance Montana is a branch office in the Zambezi Business Park in Montana, Pretoria, offering funeral insurance and related financial services as part of the wider AVBOB organisation. Through this branch, customers can arrange funeral cover products including standard and cashback funeral cover, extended family funeral cover, and a dedicated insurance scheme for pensioners, as well as group funeral cover arranged through employers or other organisations. The branch also offers life insurance, including a cashback lifestyle life insurance option, and legal insurance through the AVBOB Legal Assist product. Beyond insurance policies, AVBOB's funeral services cover burial and cremation arrangements, aquamation, and the supply of coffins, caskets, and tombstones, along with national and international repatriation services for when a body needs to be returned to another location. Customers at the Montana branch can apply for policies and manage existing cover either in person at the branch or through AVBOB's online self-service options.

Bakehouse is a European-style bakery and café on Firwood Avenue in Hazelwood, Pretoria, part of a small group of Bakehouse locations that also includes outlets in Silver Lakes Estate and Waterfall Walk in Midrand. The Hazelwood branch bakes bread, pastries, and cakes fresh daily, alongside serving coffee, breakfasts, and lunches, and offers wood-fired pizzas as part of its food menu. The café maintains a pet-friendly atmosphere, allowing customers to bring dogs along when visiting. It is open seven days a week, with shorter hours on Sundays than during the rest of the week, giving customers a consistent option for an early breakfast, a working lunch, or a late-afternoon coffee and pastry. As the original Hazelwood location within the wider Bakehouse group, the café combines daily baking with a sit-down café menu, distinguishing it from a purely takeaway bakery counter.

BICCCS is an Italian-style ice cream parlour and café on Club Avenue in Waterkloof Heights, Pretoria, serving ice cream alongside fresh bread, pastries, sandwiches, and coffee. The café has since added a dinner menu to its offering, extending beyond its original focus on ice cream, baked goods, and daytime café food into evening dining as well. It operates seven days a week, opening early in the morning and running through to the evening on most days, with slightly shorter hours on Sundays. Alongside its food and ice cream counter, the premises function as a venue where customers can sit down for a coffee and pastry earlier in the day or come back later for a full dinner, giving it a dual role as both a casual café and a more formal dining option within the same space in Waterkloof Heights.

Bidvest AFCOM manufactures and distributes packaging and fastening solutions from its facility in Hermanstad, Pretoria, serving customers across the commerce, mining, and agricultural sectors. Its product range covers packaging, labelling, fastening, strapping, tape, film, and adhesive solutions, along with thermal ink jet products used for marking and coding on production lines. The business also offers a line of eco-friendly packaging products designed to reduce single-use plastic in a customer's packaging process without compromising on protection or presentation. Alongside these core product lines, Bidvest AFCOM supplies smart automation equipment, ranging from semi-automatic machines through to fully automatic systems, aimed at customers wanting to reduce manual packaging and fastening work on their production or distribution lines. By combining consumable products such as tape and strapping with the machines needed to apply them, the business positions itself as a supplier able to support both the materials and equipment side of a customer's packaging operation.

This Bidvest Waltons branch trades from Shop 10 in the Byls Bridge Promenade centre in Highveld, Centurion, as part of the wider Bidvest Waltons stationery and office-supplies chain. The branch is open from Monday to Saturday, with shorter trading hours on Saturdays, and remains closed on Sundays. Like other branches in the chain, it runs periodic catalogue promotions covering a selection of stock, giving local customers access to discounted pricing on items within the Bidvest Waltons range for a limited period before each catalogue expires. Operating from within the Byls Bridge Promenade centre places the branch alongside a mix of other retail and service businesses, making it a convenient stop for office and stationery needs for shoppers already visiting the centre for other purposes. As a branch of a national stationery and office-supplies retailer, it draws on the buying power and product range of the broader Bidvest Waltons chain while serving customers locally from its Highveld premises.

Bila ICT Solutions is an IT hardware distributor based in Eloffsdal, Pretoria, supplying equipment from a range of established technology brands to both individual and business customers. The business offers bulk order discounts for larger purchases and builds tailored technology packages for business customers, alongside general fast delivery and customer support for smaller, individual orders. Among its specialised offerings is a data security and backup solution called Metallic Laptop Foundation, which is built on Microsoft Azure and is designed to keep laptop and desktop data protected, compliant, and recoverable for organisations supporting remote workers. It also offers FileSpace, a cloud-native file service powered by LucidLink that connects a customer's cloud storage so that it behaves like a local disk drive on their own devices. By pairing hardware distribution with these data protection and cloud-file services, Bila ICT Solutions positions itself as covering both the physical equipment and some of the software infrastructure that businesses need to run their IT operations.

Biltong@ZA, trading as Fleisherei, has been producing biltong since 2003 from its factory and head office in Louwlardia, Centurion. The business offers co-packing and private labelling services, using equipment capable of packing biltong, fresh meat, and cured products for retail, direct-to-consumer, or food-service customers in vacuum skin or modified atmosphere packaging. Alongside this manufacturing side, Fleisherei supplies meat wholesale and in bulk to some of the country's major retailers, working with local and international suppliers to source products. Its own retail footprint includes seven meat delis, eight dedicated biltong outlets, and a liquor store spread across Gauteng, in addition to an online butchery through which customers can order biltong and meat products for delivery. By combining its own factory production with co-packing work for other brands and a retail network of delis and biltong outlets, the business covers manufacturing, wholesale, and direct retail sides of the biltong and meat trade from one Centurion base.

Biscoplus (Pty) Ltd has been baking biscuits under the Henro brand since 1992, when it started as a small family business in Silverton, Pretoria. Over more than thirty years, the business has grown its range to include more than sixty biscuit varieties, organised under lines such as My Scotties, My Crunchies, Choc-Chip, Ginger, Super Creams, Creams All Day, Marie, Bisco Bites, and Disco's. What began as a family-run operation baking biscuits for South African households has since expanded into distribution across the wider African continent, while remaining a family-focused business in how it describes its approach to quality and product development. Biscoplus positions its Henro biscuits around consistent quality at competitive prices, maintaining the same baking standards across its growing number of product lines as the business has scaled up production. The Silverton facility remains the base from which the company's full biscuit range is produced and distributed to retailers both locally and further afield.

items.description: Bokamoso Environmental Consultants is an environmental consulting firm based in Ashlea Gardens, Pretoria, founded in 1992. The business specialises in environmental management and planning, together with architecture, approaching projects from the position that a healthy ecosystem and human development need to be kept in balance rather than treated as opposing goals. Its work involves environmental investigation as a basis for finding solutions tailored to each client's project, rather than applying a single standard approach regardless of the site or development involved. Bokamoso frames its mission around taking responsibility for the successful completion of projects it works on and designing in line with a broader ethical responsibility toward the environment, aiming to contribute to a more sustainable landscape through its planning and environmental work. Having operated in this field for more than three decades, the firm has built up experience applying environmental and planning principles across a range of development and land-use projects in and around Pretoria.

Boma Meat Deli is a butchery and deli outlet in the Shopping on Ridgeway centre in Midstream Ridge Estate, operating as part of the wider Boma Meat Market group. The outlet's range covers beef, chicken, lamb, and pork cuts, along with biltong, wors, mince and patties, and sosaties, as well as bulk packs for customers buying larger quantities at once. Alongside raw meat and braai products, Boma Meat Deli stocks ready-made meals, salads and sides, and baked goods and treats, giving customers deli-style options alongside the core butchery counter. It also sells firewood and related braai fuel under its own fire-fuel range, covering an additional need for customers planning a braai. Orders can be delivered directly to a customer's door as well as bought in person at the Shopping on Ridgeway store, giving residents of Midstream Ridge Estate and the surrounding area a nearby option for both everyday meat purchases and braai-focused shopping.

Bootlegger Coffee Company runs a café at Irene Link Shopping Centre in Doringkloof, Centurion, as part of a chain that was created in 2012 by three friends and has since grown into multiple stores across Cape Town and Johannesburg. Alongside its café menu, the brand sells coffee beans and ground coffee, coffee capsules, and brewing equipment such as manual grinders and espresso makers for customers wanting to recreate its coffee at home. Its retail range also extends into tea and alternatives, including matcha, as well as a lifestyle merchandise line sold alongside its coffee products. Bootlegger offers roastery tours as part of its broader brand activities, giving customers a closer look at how its coffee is roasted before it reaches individual cafés such as the Doringkloof branch. The Centurion location combines this wider product range with its own in-store café menu, serving customers coffee and food on site as well as coffee-related products to take home.
